note: Encodes every acceptance scenario of DIGITAL_ADVISOR.md as an answer sequence plus expected outcome, for testthat tests in phase 12A. Operations: change_answer (backtracking), override, language, save_restore, code_export, deep_link, planning_action. test_level 'engine' can be checked against rules.json alone; 'engine_and_ui' additionally needs the Shiny modules or templates (pending); 'static' checks the rule file itself. Review 2026-10-03.2: AS06 and AS23 answer q.records_per_individual; AS01d also checks the Brunner-Munzel alternative and the assumption a.rank_null_identical (expected key assumption_ids_include: every listed id is among the outcome's assumption ids); AS25-AS29 added. Rules 2026-10-05.1 (Boschloo variant settings and tie assumption text, decision D12) change no routing, so every scenario is unchanged; rules_version updated to match.

operation_semantics.backtracking_en: Changing the answer to a question invalidates every answer recorded after it in the trace (and any results, planning specifications or exports derived from them); the walkthrough continues from the changed question.
operation_semantics.override_policy_en: A user may replace the outcome's variant only by a variant listed in its 'alternatives' with override_allowed = true. The override is recorded with the alternative's why-not text, and the resulting status is at most 'conditional'. Variants in 'rejected_routes' are refused with the stated reason; any other variant is refused as not compatible with the recorded design.
operation_semantics.restore_policy_en: A saved state records schema_version, rules_version and the raw answer trace. Restoring with the same rules_version replays the trace and must reproduce the same outcome. A different rules_version yields 'migration_required': the state is not re-interpreted silently; an explicit migration must map answers and report changes.
operation_semantics.deep_link_policy_en: A deep link carries an answer map. It is replayed through the graph in transition order; an unknown question or option id makes the link invalid ('invalid_input'); answers to questions not reached on the path are reported as ignored_answers and do not influence the result.
operation_semantics.incomplete_policy_en: Replaying an answer set that stops at an applicable but unanswered question yields out.needs_information with pending_question_id set to that question.

scenarios.title: Two independent numeric groups: Welch by default
Two independent numeric groups, equal variances justified a priori: Student, conditional
Variance question answered 'I do not know': Welch, no downgrade (route without assumption)
Rank estimand: Wilcoxon-Mann-Whitney presented as probability of superiority, not a median test
Paired observations with missing pairs: paired t, conditional, mixed model offered
Independent binary groups: Boschloo (two-sided central)
Independent binary groups, pre-specified direction: one-sided Boschloo
Margins question answered 'I do not know': Boschloo, downgraded to conditional with recorded assumption
Both margins fixed by design: Fisher's exact test
Paired binary observations: McNemar-type test; the independent Boschloo route is rejected
Multi-group ordinal outcome: Kruskal-Wallis
Adjusted regression (model aim, several predictors)
Group comparison adjusted for covariates: ANCOVA
Clustered observations: linear mixed model, conditional
Repeated observations, complete data: RM-ANOVA with routine GG correction
Repeated observations with missing occasions: linear mixed model, conditional
Exploratory factor analysis; conventional planning not applicable
Exploratory cluster analysis with mixed variable types
Unanswered: walkthrough stops before the unit question
Aim unknown: needs information, no default
Contradictory design: 'independent groups' but individuals appear more than once
Contradictory design: duplicate records per ID and occasion in a paired design
No recorded pairing ID: needs information, pairs never guessed
Backtracking: changing the structure answer invalidates dependent answers
Method overrides: listed alternative allowed, rejected or unlisted variant refused
Language switch: German texts, identical decision
Save and restore: same rules version restores exactly; other version requires explicit migration
Code export: template id matches the recommended variant (no silent test switch)
Deep links: answer map replays to the same outcome; invalid options rejected; unreached answers ignored
Unavailable planning: Kruskal-Wallis planning explained, no manufactured sample size
Model-performance destination: held-out validation in the classification workspace
Performance evaluation design unknown: labelled exploratory, conditional
Causal question with observational data: outside supported scope
Causal question with randomised exposure: comparison route (Boschloo)
One sample without a justified reference value: estimate, no test
Spread comparison: Brown-Forsythe, chi-square variance test rejected
No normality-pre-test switching rule anywhere in the graph

expected.forbidden_option_terms_scope: option_id and label_en/label_de of every question option, and every condition in applies_when, transitions and status modifiers (which may reference only question ids and option ids). Explanatory texts may mention these tests to say that they are not used for routing.

scenarios.title: Categorical-by-continuous association: re-framed as a group comparison with a restart action
Prediction model for a binary outcome: conditional, planning not applicable, classifier workspace next
Time-to-event outcome: outside supported scope
Two trial arms measured at baseline and follow-up: groups-over-time design is re-framed, never analysed as paired
Regression with several records per individual (continuous outcome): random-intercept mixed model, conditional
Correlation with several records per individual: outside supported scope, not analysed as independent pairs
Records question unanswered: walkthrough stops, no independence is assumed
Paired rank comparison with missing pairs: conditional, modifier does not point to a mean-based alternative that is not listed

draft_check.tool: temporary Python 3.14.4 walker written for the adversarial review (an independent re-implementation of the engine semantics in this file), run from a scratch directory and deleted afterwards; not a testthat test. R 4.6.1 was used only for the r_functions existence check and an illustrative Wilcoxon-Mann-Whitney simulation (see analysis-variants.json).
draft_check.r_functions_exist: 101 of 101 entries (60 distinct package::function pairs), re-checked with requireNamespace()/exists() in R 4.6.1 on 2026-10-03

checks: unique ids; bilingual texts present
every question has a dont_know option with explanation and policy
conditions reference existing questions/options
transition orders contiguous and last transition an unconditional guard
exhaustive depth-first enumeration of all answer combinations: applies_when holds on arrival, no cycles, no guard reached
all outcomes and questions reachable; all non-guard transitions fire on some path
no outcome claims exact_gpower_match or independently_validated_extension
all variant ids, source node ids and crosswalk ids resolve; every source node appears in the crosswalk
every r_functions entry exists in the installed library
acceptance scenarios replayed with the status rules, override, backtracking, restore and deep-link semantics of engine
every crosswalk row has a non-empty difference_reason; coverage header equals project/COVERAGE.csv
every learning_method_id resolves in inst/metadata/learning-resources.json (crosswalk method_id vocabulary)
every outcome reference id exists in references
every r_template_id equals tpl.<analysis_variant_id>.v1 (code export cannot select another test)
both Boschloo outcomes carry the a.ordering_ties assumption; classifier outcomes never carry test-power planning
AS21: no option id or label (en/de) contains a normality/variance/sphericity pre-test or significance term

independent engine re-implementation: exhaustive enumeration reproduced the counts reported for rules_version 2026-10-03.1 on the unmodified files (4932 paths, 89 outcome-status combinations, 40 of 40 scenarios)

design consistency on every enumerated path: independent-group outcomes only with structure = independent and independence check = no; paired, repeated and one-sample outcomes only with the matching structure and (paired/repeated) a confirmed ID; cluster outcomes only for clusters or several records per individual; outcome-type requirements of every method outcome; no analysis outcome for groups_over_time
aims model, predict and associate with unit = individuals reach an analysis outcome only after q.records_per_individual = one, or a cluster outcome after 'several'
status modifiers that point to a mixed-model alternative only on outcomes that list lmm_repeated_measures
every needs_information or outside_supported_scope outcome has at least one next action
every analysis-variant used_by list equals the usage in rules.json
all 4932 answer paths of rules_version 2026-10-03.1 replayed on 2026-10-03.2: 360 now stop at q.records_per_individual (pending), all others give the same outcome and status
